items.title: llm 0.37
items.snippet: Release: llm 0.37 There's a lot of stuff in this new release of my LLM CLI tool and Python library, representing around two months of accumulated features and fixes. I added gpt-6.1-sol and gpt-6.1-terra , plus a new llm openai endpoint add command to make it easier to configure additional models that use OpenAI-compatible endpoints. I switched the default model (if you have not set your own default) to gpt-6-luna - half the price of the previous default, gpt-5.6-luna . LLM's support for embeddi
items.title_ar: إصدار llm 0.37 مع موديلات OpenAI جديدة وأمر لإضافة endpoints
items.summary_ar: أصدر Simon Willison نسخة llm 0.37 من أداة CLI ومكتبة Python الخاصة به، وتضمنت نحو شهرين من الميزات والإصلاحات. أضافت النسخة موديلي gpt-6.1-sol وgpt-6.1-terra، وأمر llm openai endpoint add لتسهيل إضافة موديلات تعتمد على API متوافق مع OpenAI. كما تغير الموديل الافتراضي إلى gpt-6-luna بنصف سعر الموديل السابق.
items.why_ar: إذا كنت تبني POCs حول LLM CLI أو تستخدم OpenAI-compatible endpoints، فهذا الإصدار يبسط ربط موديلات جديدة وتجربتها بسرعة.
items.title_en: llm 0.37 adds GPT-6.1 models and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint command
items.summary_en: Simon Willison released llm 0.37, the CLI tool and Python library, bundling about two months of features and fixes. It adds gpt-6.1-sol and gpt-6.1-terra, plus a new llm openai endpoint add command for configuring models behind OpenAI-compatible endpoints. The default model switched to gpt-6-luna, at half the price of the previous default.
items.why_en: If your POCs use LLM CLI or OpenAI-compatible endpoints, this release makes it faster to wire up and benchmark new models.

items.title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
items.snippet: RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return.
items.title_ar: Anthropic تحذر من قرب الوصول إلى قدرة RSI
items.summary_ar: تحذر Anthropic من أنها أصبحت قريبة جداً من قدرة RSI، أي أن يصبح الذكاء الاصطناعي قادراً على تدريب نفسه بشكل يسرّع تطوره بصورة كبيرة. يعتبر المتشائمون من المخاطر أن RSI نقطة لا عودة منها.
items.why_ar: هذا الموضوع يهم أبحاثك وتقييمك للمخاطر، ويصلح كمحور لورقة بحثية حول self-improvement وسلامة الموديلات.
items.title_en: Anthropic warns it is very close to RSI capability
items.summary_en: Anthropic warns it is very close to RSI, the point where AI becomes so good at training itself that its capabilities accelerate dramatically. AI doomers see RSI as a point of no return.
items.why_en: It is a strong topic for research on self-improvement and model safety, and worth tracking closely.

items.title: N1nEmAn/sapper-v2
items.snippet: Autonomous pentest legion — AI commander + worker swarm + layered fact-intent graph. 3rd Tencent Intelligent Attack-Defense online champion (634 teams · 8h unattended · 1B tokens beat 4.5B). The Nüwa Test: give AIs Create/Language/History, let a civilization grow.
items.title_ar: sapper-v2: منظومة agents مستقلة لـ pentest آلي
items.summary_ar: ريبو مفتوح يصف legion للـ pentest الآلي يجمع AI commander وworker swarm وlayered fact-intent graph. يذكر الريبو أنه حصل على المركز الثالث في Tencent Intelligent Attack-Defense online champion بين 634 فريقاً، وعمل 8 ساعات دون تدخل باستخدام 1B tokens متفوقاً على تشغيل بـ 4.5B tokens. كما يقدم Nüwa Test لاختبار نمو حضارة بين AIs.
items.why_ar: مرجع عملي لمعمارية multi-agent في POC أمني أو مشاركة في مسابقة.
items.title_en: sapper-v2: Autonomous Pentest Legion of AI Agent Swarms
items.summary_en: An open-source autonomous pentest legion combining an AI commander, a worker swarm, and a layered fact-intent graph. The project reports third place in the Tencent Intelligent Attack-Defense online championship among 634 teams, running 8 hours unattended with 1B tokens and beating a 4.5B-token run. It also includes a Nüwa Test that gives AIs Create, Language, and History capabilities to watch a civilization grow.
items.why_en: A concrete multi-agent architecture reference for a security POC or competition entry.

items.title: eliasbiondo/antirion
items.snippet: 🕷️ The fastest open-source AI Gateway and LLM Gateway — one binary with built-in console to route, secure, budget and observe every LLM call across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock and more.
items.title_ar: antirion: open-source AI Gateway لتوجيه ومراقبة استدعاءات LLM
items.summary_ar: أداة open-source مكتوبة كـ binary واحد مع console مدمج، تُوجّه كل استدعاء LLM وتؤمّنه وتضع له budget وتراقبه. تدعم OpenAI وAnthropic وGemini وBedrock وغيرها.
items.why_ar: مفيد لأي POC يستخدم أكثر من موديل ويحتاج التحكم في التكلفة والأمان والمراقبة من مكان واحد.
items.title_en: antirion: Fast Open-Source AI Gateway for LLM Calls
items.summary_en: antirion is an open-source AI Gateway shipped as one binary with a built-in console. It routes, secures, budgets, and observes every LLM call across OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Bedrock, and more.
items.why_en: Useful if your POCs call multiple LLM providers and you need cost, security, and observability control in one place.

items.title: ctoldigital/axuse
items.snippet: Accessibility-first browser & computer use for AI agents — one MCP server for every harness (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Antigravity). Instruments the DOM/accessibility tree via CDP instead of screenshot loops: diffed snapshots, stable element refs, trusted input, typed errors. Zero dependencies
items.title_ar: axuse: MCP server لتحكم الـ agents بالمتصفح عبر accessibility tree
items.summary_ar: أداة browser وcomputer use تركز على accessibility أولاً، وتعمل كـ MCP server واحد لعدة harnesses مثل Codex وClaude Code وOpenCode وAntigravity. بدلاً من حلقات screenshot تقرأ DOM وaccessibility tree عبر CDP، مع diffed snapshots ومراجع عناصر ثابتة وtrusted input وtyped errors. يصف المشروع نفسه بأنه بلا dependencies.
items.why_ar: بديل عملي لحلقات screenshot في browser agents يستحق التجربة ضمن POCs الوكلاء.
items.title_en: axuse: Accessibility-First Browser Use via One MCP Server
items.summary_en: axuse is an accessibility-first browser and computer use tool that exposes one MCP server for multiple harnesses such as Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, and Antigravity. Instead of screenshot loops, it instruments the DOM and accessibility tree via CDP, offering diffed snapshots, stable element refs, trusted input, and typed errors. It describes itself as having zero dependencies.
items.why_en: A practical alternative to screenshot-based browser agents worth testing in your agent POCs.

items.title: Goldman bans traders and bankers from using AI coding tools

items.title_en: Goldman Sachs bans traders and staff from AI coding tools
items.summary_en: Bloomberg reports that Goldman Sachs has banned traders and other employees from using advanced AI tools for coding over productivity and risk concerns.

items.title: Dost launches AskDost to give finance teams their own AI agents
items.snippet: Dost, the native-AI finance automation platform, has launched AskDost, an AI business intelligence assistant built for finance and operations teams. AskDost connects to a company’s ERP and other financial data sources, answers questions in natural language, executes finance workflows once a human approves them, and lets each team run AI agents on its own data.
items.title_ar: Dost تطلق AskDost لمنح فرق المالية وكلاء AI خاصة بها
items.summary_ar: أطلقت Dost منصة AskDost، وهي مساعد ذكاء أعمال مبني على AI لفرق المالية والعمليات. يتصل بنظام ERP ومصادر البيانات المالية، ويجيب عن الأسئلة بلغة طبيعية.
items.why_ar: نموذج واضح لدمج agent مع ERP مع موافقة بشرية قبل تنفيذ سير العمل، ويصلح مرجعاً لـ POC داخلي.
items.title_en: Dost launches AskDost to give finance teams their own AI agents
items.summary_en: Dost has launched AskDost, an AI business intelligence assistant for finance and operations teams. It connects to an ERP and other financial data sources, answers questions in natural language, and runs finance workflows only after human approval. Each team can run AI agents on its own data.
items.why_en: It is a clear model of an agent integrated with an ERP under human approval controls, useful as a reference for an internal POC.

items.title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan uses AI agents so much, he spends up to $200K a year on tokens
items.snippet: Y Combinator Garry Tan has jokingly admitted that he's suffered from "cyber psychosis” and barely sleeps sometimes because he’s so excited to be working with his AI agents. On a new episode of Walter Isaacson’s podcast, The Builders, Tan put a price tag on his passion.
items.title_ar: Garry Tan ينفق حتى 200 ألف دولار سنوياً على tokens لاستخدام AI agents
items.summary_ar: ذكر Garry Tan من Y Combinator في بودكاست The Builders أنه يعمل مع AI agents بكثافة كبيرة، وأنه يقلل ساعات نومه بسبب حماسه لها. وكشف أن إنفاقه على tokens قد يصل إلى 200 ألف دولار في السنة.
items.why_ar: يعكس هذا الخبر حجم الاستهلاك الفعلي لل agents، وهو مؤشر مهم عند تقدير تكلفة الـ inference في أي POC قبل توسيعه.
items.title_en: Garry Tan spends up to $200K a year on tokens running AI agents
items.summary_en: On a new episode of Walter Isaacson's podcast The Builders, Y Combinator's Garry Tan said he works so intensively with his AI agents that he barely sleeps. He put a figure on it: up to $200K a year spent on tokens.
items.why_en: It is a concrete data point on real-world token spend for agent workloads, useful when estimating costs before scaling a POC.

items.title: New York Times and other outlets sue web browser Brave over alleged content scraping
items.snippet: The New York Times is suing privacy-focused web browser company Brave for allegedly scraping the outlet’s copyrighted content and unlawfully distributing it to its own customers, like Anthropic and Perplexity.
items.title_ar: New York Times تقاضي Brave بسبب كشط المحتوى
items.summary_ar: رفعت New York Times ومؤسسات إعلامية أخرى دعوى ضد متصفح Brave، متهمةً إياه بكشط محتواها المحمي بحقوق النشر وتوزيعه بشكل غير قانوني على عملائه، ومنهم Anthropic وPerplexity.
items.why_ar: تؤثر قضايا جمع البيانات وحقوق النشر على مصادر dataset التي قد تستخدمها في تدريب أو تقييم الموديلات، لذا تستحق المتابعة.
items.title_en: New York Times and other outlets sue Brave over alleged content scraping
items.summary_en: The New York Times is suing the privacy-focused browser company Brave. It alleges Brave scraped copyrighted content and unlawfully distributed it to customers including Anthropic and Perplexity.
items.why_en: Copyright disputes over scraped data affect which datasets are safe to use for training and evaluation.

items.title: GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents
items.snippet: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in multi-turn agentic workloads that require sustained interaction with complex environments. Existing reflective prompt optimizers such as GEPA learn from failed rollouts, but agentic failures can also come from prompt weaknesses, harness limitations, stochastic execution, or noisy judges. We argue that such failures may not provide useful learning signal, and may even be harmful; and thus it is essential to curate which tasks are provided to the prompt optimizer for better performance. We introduce GEPA-Curator, a framework that augments the prompt optimizer to select which agent experiences should shape prompt optimization. In particular,
items.title_ar: GEPA-Curator: تعلم منتقى لتحسين agents ذاتياً
items.summary_ar: تقدم الورقة GEPA-Curator، وهو إطار يضيف إلى GEPA prompt optimizer قدرة اختيار تجارب الـ agent التي ستشكّل تحسين الـ prompt. تجادل الورقة بأن الإخفاقات في multi-turn agentic workloads قد تأتي من ضعف الـ prompt أو قيود harness أو noisy judges، وقد لا تحمل إشارة تعلم مفيدة بل قد تضر. لذلك يُنصح بانتقاء المهام قبل تغذيتها للمحسّن.
items.why_ar: مفيد إذا كنت تشغّل reflective prompt optimization على agents وتحتاج تصفية الإخفاقات الصاخبة قبل التحسين.
items.title_en: GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents
items.summary_en: The paper introduces GEPA-Curator, a framework that augments the GEPA prompt optimizer to select which agent experiences shape prompt optimization. It argues that failures in multi-turn agentic LLM workloads can stem from prompt weaknesses, harness limits, stochastic execution, or noisy judges, and may provide little or even harmful learning signal. Curating tasks before optimization is presented as essential for better performance.
items.why_en: Relevant if you run reflective prompt optimization on agents and need to filter noisy failures before tuning.

items.title: SOMA: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained Egocentric Behavior and Body-Motion Understanding
items.snippet: Perceiving human body motion is critical for multimodal systems that understand and assist people. Yet current evaluations of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) largely focus on objects, scenes, and coarse actions, leaving their ability to reason about the body itself poorly assessed. This is especially challenging from the egocentric perspective, in which the body is only partially visible and motion must be inferred from occluded and temporally distributed cues. We introduce SOMA, a benchmark for fine-grained body-motion understanding from egocentric video, comprising 1,632 human-verified questions across three capability axes: body configuration, motion dynamics, and temporal reason
items.title_ar: SOMA: benchmark لفهم حركة الجسم بدقة من منظور egocentric
items.summary_ar: يقدم SOMA، وهو benchmark لفهم حركة الجسم الدقيقة من فيديو egocentric، ويضم 1,632 سؤالاً تم التحقق منها بشرياً. تغطي الأسئلة ثلاثة محاور هي body configuration وmotion dynamics وtemporal reasoning. يختبر البنشمارك قدرة MLLMs على استنتاج الحركة من إشارات محجوبة جزئياً لأن الجسم يظهر جزئياً في هذا المنظور.
items.why_ar: مفيد لتقييم MLLMs في أنظمة مساعدة تعتمد على فهم حركة الجسم وليس الأشياء فقط.
items.title_en: SOMA: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained Egocentric Behavior and Body-Motion Understanding
items.summary_en: SOMA is a benchmark for fine-grained body-motion understanding from egocentric video, comprising 1,632 human-verified questions. The questions span three capability axes: body configuration, motion dynamics, and temporal reasoning. It targets MLLMs whose body reasoning is poorly assessed, since the body is only partially visible and motion must be inferred from occluded cues.
items.why_en: Useful for evaluating MLLMs on body-motion reasoning in egocentric assistant scenarios.

items.title: OSWAM: An Effective World Action Model with One-Step Action Generation
items.snippet: Direct-policy World Action Models (WAM) have demonstrated the benefits of decoupling action generation from explicit future visual prediction for efficient inference in autonomous driving and embodied control. However, they still require tens of denoising steps to achieve competitive action quality, incurring substantial latency and hindering real-time deployment. Simply reducing the number of denoising steps will collapse the nonlinear multi-step denoising trajectory into coarse updates, substantially degrading action quality. To reduce the denoising steps while enabling real-time action generation, we present an effective world action model with one-step action generation, namely OSWAM, fo
items.title_ar: OSWAM: World Action Model بتوليد أفعال في خطوة واحدة
items.summary_ar: تعالج الورقة زمن الاستدلال في Direct-policy World Action Models، لأن النسخ الحالية تحتاج عشرات denoising steps لتحقيق جودة أفعال تنافسية. تقليل عدد الخطوات وحده يفسد مسار الـ denoising متعدد الخطوات ويقلل جودة الفعل. يقترح OSWAM توليد الأفعال في خطوة واحدة لتمكين التنفيذ في الوقت الحقيقي في القيادة الذاتية والتحكم المجسد.
items.why_ar: تقنية تستحق المتابعة إذا كان مشروعك في الروبوتات أو القيادة الذاتية يتعطل بسبب latency الـ denoising.
items.title_en: OSWAM: An Effective World Action Model with One-Step Action Generation
items.summary_en: The paper tackles latency in Direct-policy World Action Models, which need tens of denoising steps to reach competitive action quality. Simply reducing steps collapses the multi-step denoising trajectory into coarse updates and degrades action quality. OSWAM proposes one-step action generation to enable real-time deployment in autonomous driving and embodied control.
items.why_en: Worth tracking if your real-time robotics or driving use case is blocked by denoising latency.

items.why_en: A reference for evidence-chain and reproducibility ideas when building agent-driven research systems.

items.title: AuditFL: A Contract-Backed Clearing Layer for Open Federated Learning
items.snippet: Federated learning (FL) keeps raw data local, but most deployments still rely on a trusted coordinator for client admission, checkpoint distribution, update collection, aggregation, and rewards. This paper presents AuditFL, a contract-backed clearing layer for auditable FL in open settings. AuditFL keeps training and aggregation off chain, stores model artifacts in an assumed reliable off-chain artifact store, and records only content identifiers and economic state on chain. Clients reserve update tickets with deposits, publish update identifiers, and later claim refunds or rewards; the task coordinator publishes global checkpoints and finalizes rounds through deterministic settlement rules.
items.title_ar: AuditFL: طبقة تسوية مدعومة بـ contract-backed لـ Federated Learning مفتوح
items.summary_ar: تقترح الورقة AuditFL، وهي طبقة clearing مدعومة بـ contract لتعلم موزع قابل للتدقيق في بيئات مفتوحة. يبقى التدريب والتجميع off-chain، وتُخزَّن الـ model artifacts في artifact store موثوق مفترض، بينما يُسجَّل on-chain فقط content identifiers والحالة الاقتصادية. يودع العملاء deposits لحجز update tickets ثم يطالبون بالاسترداد أو المكافآت، ويُنهي الـ coordinator الجولات بقواعد settlement حتمية.
items.why_ar: مفيد لمهندس يبني حلول Federated Learning تحتاج تدقيقاً وحوافز بدون الاعتماد على coordinator موثوق.
items.title_en: AuditFL: A Contract-Backed Clearing Layer for Open Federated Learning
items.summary_en: The paper proposes AuditFL, a contract-backed clearing layer for auditable federated learning in open settings. Training and aggregation stay off chain, model artifacts live in an assumed reliable off-chain store, and only content identifiers and economic state are recorded on chain. Clients reserve update tickets with deposits and later claim refunds or rewards, while the coordinator finalizes rounds through deterministic settlement rules.
items.why_en: Useful for an engineer building federated POCs that need auditability and incentives without a trusted coordinator.
